verdict.rationale: CoreWeave can be driven without the console: its Terraform/OpenTofu provider manages CKS clusters, VPCs, storage and inference as code. A CKS API creates, lists, updates and deletes clusters, and the Inference API uses bearer tokens with generated clients in many languages. API access tokens and kubeconfigs let kubectl authenticate non-interactively, so the core of headless automation is clearly documented. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions or service-account/machine-identity tokens), evidence of a first-party CoreWeave CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
